headline: Item Randomizer protects existing saves, and lock-strafe can share the shoulder buttons
summary: Item Randomizer 2.4.1 was released with New games only enabled by default, keeping a playthrough unchanged unless its save carries the current seed's tag. Going Commando also gets vendor stock refreshed on every level, the host's seed in a party, and fixes for equipping randomized rewards. Multiplayer 0.12.2 was released with Going Commando menu pages and parties restricted to the same game's family.
highlights: Difficulty 1.5.0 brings its Health pickups slider and Chaos's Nanotech surge to Going Commando. Xbox Icons 1.2.0 fixes buttons in that game's title menus.
Item Randomizer 2.4.1 puts its files in the port's mod folder, accessible through Mod files on Android. The equivalent Multiplayer 0.12.3 change landed but was not released that day (#148).
Lock-strafe 1.2.0 was released with L2-only, R2-only or both as the strafe button. Choosing one leaves the other available to the game and other mods, including Wrench Throw (#153).
The index now lists Wrench Throw, for throwing the OmniWrench while moving, and Weapon Wheel Pause, for pausing gameplay while Quick Select stays responsive (#143, #144).
#145 proposes a fix for an Archipelago Gadgetron PDA crash when no vendor items can be bought. It remains unmerged.
